question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Illicit
solution:
The correct answer is: **Illegal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"illicit"** means something that is forbidden by law, rules, or custom; illegal. (अवैध)
 
 
• **Example:** The police cracked down on illicit drug trade in the neighborhood.
 
 
 
• **"Illegal"** refers to something that is prohibited by law; unlawful. (गैरकानूनी)
 
 
• **Example:** It is illegal to drive without a valid license.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym of 'illicit' is 'illegal'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Illegal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Integral** (अखंड): Necessary to make a whole complete; essential.
 
 
• **Example:** She is an integral part of the team.
 
 
 
• **Inessential** (गैर जरूरी): Not essential; not necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** Many inessential items can be removed from your shopping list to save money.
 
 
 
• **Inaugural** (उद्घाटन): Marking the beginning of an institution, activity, or period of office.
 
 
• **Example:** The inaugural ceremony was attended by many dignitaries.
